description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based remotely in the United States. 

 As an AI Engineer, you will help shape the next generation of intelligent manufacturing systems by developing advanced computer vision and multimodal AI models. You will define technical architecture and lead the development of models capable of interpreting real-time factory environments and translating visual insights into operational decisions. Working across detection, vision-language models, and vision-language-action systems, you will take solutions from research and experimentation to production deployment. You will also build scalable data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and optimized inference systems for both cloud and edge environments. Collaborating with engineering, research, and product teams, you will influence technical direction and mentor other engineers. Your work will directly improve manufacturing quality, efficiency, safety, and automation.



Accountabilities:
 
 You will lead the technical development and deployment of advanced AI models, ensuring they deliver reliable performance in real-world industrial environments. Your responsibilities will include:


 
 Define technical strategy and architecture for computer vision models, including detection, vision-language models (VLMs), and vision-language-action (VLA) workloads.



 
 Train, fine-tune, and adapt models such as YOLO variants, open-source VLMs, and VLA policies using proprietary datasets.



 
 Apply model optimization techniques, including knowledge distillation, quantization, and LoRA-based adaptation.



 
 Build and improve data engines, including labeling pipelines, foundation-model-assisted auto-labeling, active learning, and synthetic or simulated data generation.



 
 Design rigorous evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, regression test suites, and failure-mode analyses to measure model performance.



 
 Establish online metrics connected to real product and operational outcomes.



 
 Deploy models into production environments while meeting latency, memory, and cost constraints across cloud GPUs and edge hardware.



 
 Optimize inference and deployment using technologies such as TensorRT, ONNX, NVIDIA Jetson, or comparable platforms.



 
 Lead cross-functional technical initiatives, prepare architecture and design documentation, review code and models, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers.



 
 Monitor advances in AI research, assess emerging technologies, and translate relevant developments into prototypes and production-ready capabilities.




 Requirements :

 The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on machine learning expertise with the technical leadership required to guide complex AI initiatives from research through production. You should have a strong background in computer vision and multimodal learning, along with experience building reliable systems at scale. Key qualifications include:


 
 5+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems, particularly in computer vision.



 
 Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



 
 Extensive hands-on experience with object detection and segmentation models, including YOLO-family and DETR-style architectures.



 
 Practical experience training, tuning, and deploying computer vision models in production environments.



 
 Experience working with vision-language models such as LLaVA, Qwen-VL, or PaliGemma, including fine-tuning, prompting, grounding, and evaluation.



 
 Experience with vision-language-action models, embodied AI, or robot-learning systems such as OpenVLA, RT-2, or pi0, or a strong track record in adjacent multimodal AI fields.



 
 Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and familiarity with distributed training, mixed-precision techniques, and GPU profiling.



 
 Proven ability to take models from research to production, including optimization, inference serving, monitoring, and continuous improvement based on real-world performance.



 
 Demonstrated technical leadership, including setting direction across teams, making informed build-versus-adopt decisions, and raising engineering standards.



 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, researchers, and product leaders.




 Nice to Have:


 
 Research publications or open-source contributions in computer vision or multimodal learning.



 
 Experience with video understanding, 3D perception, or multi-sensor fusion.



 
 Familiarity with simulation, sim-to-real transfer, reinforcement learning, or imitation learning.



 
 Experience deploying models on edge and embedded devices, including TensorRT, CUDA, and quantization-aware training.



 
 Knowledge of LLM infrastructure and tooling such as vLLM.



 
 Experience with RLHF-style post-training techniques for multimodal models.




 Benefits :


 
 Market-competitive salary based on experience and location.



 
 Equity participation in a high-growth AI company.



 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.



 
 Flexible paid time off.



 
 Professional development opportunities.



 
 Remote-first working environment supported by modern collaboration tools.



 
 Opportunity to work with experienced engineering talent on advanced Vision AI and IoT solutions.



 
 Exposure to diverse manufacturing environments and real-world industrial AI applications.



 
 Opportunity to lead strategic technical initiatives and contribute directly to product and business growth.
